Elevate Your Look with Simple Enhancements

Beautifully groomed brows and lashes can create symmetry, open up the eyes, and give the face a more youthful appearance. Our aesthetician uses expert techniques and medical-grade products to ensure natural-looking results customized to your unique facial features.

Each enhancement service is quick, non-invasive, and provides instant gratification—no needles or downtime required.

Brow Wax

Sculpted brows begin with careful shaping. Our brow waxing service removes unwanted hair and defines the arch based on your natural bone structure. The result is a symmetrical, refined appearance that enhances your facial harmony. Our aesthetician tailors each wax to your desired style—from bold and structured to soft and natural.

Brow Tint

Add depth and definition to your natural brows with semi-permanent brow tinting. This treatment is ideal for those with light, sparse, or uneven brows who want a fuller look without the need for daily makeup. Tints are customized to complement your skin tone and hair color, creating a subtle enhancement that lasts up to four weeks.

Lash Tint

For those seeking the effect of mascara without the smudge or effort, a lash tint is a perfect solution. This safe, eye-area-specific treatment darkens your natural lashes, making them appear longer, fuller, and more noticeable. Especially beneficial for individuals with naturally light lashes, lash tinting offers a low-maintenance way to keep your eyes looking defined and awake.

Frequently Asked Questions About Brow & Lash Enhancements

How long do tint results last?

Typically, brow and lash tints last 3 to 4 weeks, depending on your hair growth and skincare routine.

Will tinting damage my lashes or brows?

No. We use professional, gentle products designed specifically for safe use around the eyes.

Is brow waxing painful?

Most clients describe it as a brief, mild discomfort. It’s quick and tolerable.

How often should I come in?

Many patients schedule maintenance every 4–6 weeks to keep results fresh and consistent.
